profile.name: Rhea Finance
profile.description:
Rhea is a chain-abstracted liquidity platform on NEAR, where trading, lending and earning work across chains instead of inside one. It runs on NEAR Intents: a user states the outcome they want — asset, price and chain — and solvers compete to fill it at the best rate, with a verifier contract on NEAR settling each fill on-chain.

The DEX pairs the deepest liquidity on NEAR with aggregation across supported networks, mixing concentrated pools for capital-efficient pairs with standard ones. Rhea Lending supplies collateral on one chain and borrows on another, settled by solvers. Rhea Predict adds prediction markets, and the Solver Liquidity Program keeps capital productive — idle liquidity earns in Rhea Lending and deploys automatically when a fill needs it. Staking brings rNEAR for NEAR and xRHEA for RHEA, boosting lending and farming rewards while DEX revenue cycles into RHEA buybacks.
